market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC currently ~$76,300; needs to dip to $50k = -34% by Dec 31, 2026. YTD low is ~$60k (Feb). A break below the $60k support to reach $50k is plausible given bearish technicals (yields rising, momentum fading). Some analysts target $57k bottom in October. With 8 months left, moderate probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether existing $60k support holds or breaks under macro pressure.
